statement: Phi=(e_obs, omega or Gamma, psi_m, X^A, kappa_eff, A_3, B_ref/top).
implication: e_obs owns clocks/orbits/sources; X^A are MTS motion/time/domain/memory/range sectors; A_3 can freeze kappa_eff locally.

statement: S_min = S_EH[e_obs,kappa_eff] + S_matter[psi_m,e_obs] + S_X[X,e_obs] + S_kappa_top[kappa_eff,A_3] + S_boundary[e_obs,B_ref] + S_readout_constraint.
implication: this is a construction contract, not a claim that the corpus already supplies all terms.

statement: At X=X0, C_i(X0)=partial_A C_i(X0)=0, positive non-gauge Hessian, and d kappa_eff=0, the local exterior equations and symplectic charge reduce to EH plus residuals.
implication: this is how MTS can reduce to GR locally without being only GR globally.

statement: S_matter depends on e_obs and psi_m only at leading local order; J_H[tau] := delta S_matter/delta e_obs contracted with tau.
implication: source universality and WEP are owned by the action if no X^A species/source slot survives.

statement: Pi_M J_H is identified with the covariant phase-space Hamiltonian mass-charge map ell_H[J_H;tau,S] omega_M^H.
implication: this is the live identity; without it, Pi_M may be a conserved wrong object.

statement: W_source := supp(J_H[e_obs,tau]) and S1,S2 must link the same W_source before fitting any exterior readout.
implication: this turns worldtube selection into source support, not a post-readout domain choice.

statement: S_boundary must make H_tau integrable with one reference and zero compact exterior flux from B_ref/top, symplectic improvements, and inner/outer boundaries.
implication: B_zero_flux remains open until the boundary variation is actually computed.

statement: The minimal action/charge contract is coherent, but it is not yet a derived MTS parent action because PiM adoption, X-sector double zeros, and boundary zero are unsigned.
implication: do not claim Newton/local-GR; use this to drive the next coefficient extraction.
